# GitHub label taxonomy

Apply these labels when triaging issues and pull requests.

| Label | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `bug` | Reproducible defects |
| `feature` | New capability requests |
| `documentation` | Docs only changes |
| `security` | Security fixes (not public vuln reports) |
| `good first issue` | Low-risk starter tasks |
| `help wanted` | Maintainer welcomes external help |
| `monitoring` | Check engine, verification, schedules |
| `status-pages` | Public status surfaces |
| `integrations` | Slack, Discord, webhooks, email |
| `self-hosting` | Docker, compose, operator docs |
| `performance` | Latency, worker throughput |
| `design` | UI/UX and visual system |

## Guidelines

- Use one primary type label (`bug`, `feature`, `documentation`)
- Add area labels when they help discovery
- Do not mark security architecture work as `good first issue`
- Close duplicate issues with a link to the canonical thread
